content.value_statement: Producing natural narration often requires manual setup across voice, model, and format options. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code run ElevenLabs TTS through the inference.sh CLI.
actual_capabilities: Generate speech from supplied text with the ElevenLabs TTS app on inference.sh.
Select named voices such as Aria, George, Bella, Brian, and Daniel.
Choose multilingual, turbo, or flash ElevenLabs models for quality or latency needs.
Tune stability, similarity boost, style, and speaker boost settings.
Request MP3 or PCM output formats for different production workflows.
Combine generated voiceover output with a documented video generation workflow.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI, an authenticated account, and network access.
Sends provided text to an external speech generation service.
Does not add voice cloning, transcript editing, or content moderation by itself.
Quality, latency, and language support depend on ElevenLabs and inference.sh availability.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Demo Narration
use_cases.description: Create clear voiceovers for product videos, sales demos, and short launch clips.

use_cases.title: Localize Course Audio
use_cases.description: Generate multilingual narration for training modules and learning content.

use_cases.title: Draft Phone System Prompts
use_cases.description: Prepare professional IVR greetings, support messages, and status announcements.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Voiceover
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short narration clip.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the elevenlabs-tts skill to generate a short product demo voiceover. Use voice Aria and default settings. Return the audio result location and settings used.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Voices
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose a voice for brand narration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate the same 30 second script with voices George and Bella. Summarize the tone differences and recommend one for a professional demo.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Expressive Delivery
prompt_templates.scenario: Refine the voice settings for a specific mood.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an expressive narration using voice Jessica. Adjust stability, similarity boost, and style for a warm but polished delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Build Multilingual Narration
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate English, Spanish, and French versions of this launch script with the multilingual model. Keep voice choice and output format consistent.

output_examples.input: A product team needs a 20 second launch narration in a friendly voice.
output_examples.output: Generated a short MP3 voiceover with Aria, using default quality settings and the provided launch script.

output_examples.input: A training team needs the same course intro in Spanish and French.
output_examples.output: Created multilingual narration versions with the multilingual model and recorded the selected voice for reuse.

output_examples.input: A support team needs a calm phone greeting with clear diction.
output_examples.output: Produced an IVR-style greeting with a professional voice and conservative tuning for consistent delivery.

best_practices: Review scripts for secrets, personal data, and unreleased information before generation.
Choose the model based on quality needs, latency targets, and language requirements.
Record the voice, model, format, and tuning values used for approved production audio.
anti_patterns: Sending passwords, API keys, private customer details, or confidential drafts as TTS input.
Using the fastest model for final long-form narration without checking audio quality.
Changing voices or tuning settings across related assets without a review pass.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates speech audio from text using ElevenLabs models through the inference.sh CLI.

faq.question: Does it require an external service?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires inference.sh CLI access, login, and network access to run the TTS app.

faq.question: Can I choose different voices?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill lists more than 22 named voices with different tones and accents.

faq.question: Can it generate multilingual audio?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented multilingual model supports many languages, including Spanish, French, German, Chinese, and Japanese.

faq.question: Can I control the voice style?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents stability, similarity boost, style, and speaker boost controls.

faq.question: Should I send sensitive text?
faq.answer: No. Treat all input as data sent to an external generation service and remove sensitive content first.
